claims.quote: There, folded into the soft linen among small papers, lay a heavy gold ring stamped with the Harrow crest and a single browned petal as if a blossom had been pressed and kept with the writing.
She drew them out and brought them up the stone steps under Anne's steady hands.
It was a crate that came from the orchard this morning; Thomas Byrd handled the orchard runs today.
It was a crate that came from the orchard this morning; Thomas Byrd handled the orchard runs today.
There, folded into the soft linen among small papers, lay a heavy gold ring stamped with the Harrow crest and a single browned petal as if a blossom had been pressed and kept with the writing.
"I observed patterns, my lord," she said quietly. "The missing apron, the scrap in the crate, his lingering by the wall. I bring them as I said I would."
The great pews took their weight like a court.

"It is true," she said. "He is mine. Thomas and I—" She stopped once, the breath taken like a small animal. "I gave him my mother's locket. I have written to him. I have met him here, in the orchard. If there is blame to be borne, let it be mine."
"There will be a hearing at dawn to determine the house's sentence. Until then both the ring and the papers will be kept in my charge; Mistress Anne, you will catalogue and secure them."

Lady Margaret Stone sat near the front, hands folded in the way propriety taught a young woman to make herself an instrument of the house.
Lord Harrow turned then to Thomas himself and, with the formalities of the house about him, asked the servant to speak.
"I gave him my mother's locket. I have written to him. I have met him here, in the orchard. If there is blame to be borne, let it be mine."
